text: For they come from where the shamrocks grow. Up in the spark are the beasts, one after the other, cleaning the iris floor. You can turn the stone and kiss past the blitz, take the lettuces with prudence. There's a kind that burns and make your poor heart yearn, and squeeze if you please. There's a calling that you need, so you'd want to say, go on, take the heart away, and divide it up among those troubling days.
